newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY BUX FUTURES TO OPEN FOR FOREIGNERS JAN 24.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY BUX FUTURES TO OPEN FOR FOREIGNERS JAN 24.

text.p: Hungary's Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) cleared the way for foreign investors to trade in futures of its official BUX share index from January 24, the BSE said in a statement in its official gazette on Tuesday.

The BSE said that by December 31, 10 of its members, entitled to take part in standardised futures trade, had modified their internal business regulations with the approval of the State Securities and Bourse Supervision so as to be able to accept orders from foreigners.
Only BSE members which make the required changes in their business regulations will be able to trade in BUX futures, the BSE said.
